issue.body:
## What is the purpose of the change

issue #2708 

## Brief changelog

if connect or read timeout occur when fetch offset from broker, queue offset will be reset to minLogicOffset as issue(#2708) showed , the way to fix this is to take care of RemotingException specially, if queryOffsetRequest got timeout, we should execute pullRequestLater other then use -1 to request.

issue.body:
1. When the network is unstable and clients establish connections repeatedly, there may be loss offset.
2. Client submit wrong offset -1
3. Broker fix offset to broker min offset
4. Client reconsume all message in specific queues
